title: Moeb Signal
description: Schema for a diagnostic signal emitted by the QA Architect during a moeb run end-of-skill review or post-run signal retrospective. Each signal file in .moeb/signals/catalogue/ must conform to this schema.

signal_id.description: Canonical UUID v4 identifier. Stable across all occurrences and status transitions. Never reused or reassigned.

category.description: Classifies the signal by the kind of improvement it represents. Error: a recoverable failure that degraded run quality or caused a rubric violation. NewCapability: a missing moeb tool or feature that forced an external or unsupported workaround. SkillImprovement: a skill file instruction that produced suboptimal or incorrect agent behaviour. ToolImprovement: a moeb tool implementation defect that did not cause complete failure but increased cost or produced incorrect output. ProcessImprovement: a gap in the run, spec, or fix_signal workflow lifecycle that caused unnecessary manual intervention.

severity.description: Impact on run quality. Critical: caused a rubric failure, data corruption, or required significant recovery work (e.g. full file rewrite). Major: caused measurable degradation — extra tool calls, partial output loss, or repeated retries — without complete failure. Minor: a process or guidance gap with low immediate impact but recurring cost if unaddressed.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary used as the index label and fix_signal selection display. Should be unique across the catalogue and unambiguous without context.

description.description: Full narrative of what happened: observed symptoms, recovery path taken, relevant file paths or tool names, and why the issue recurs. Must be sufficient for a spec author to understand root cause without reading the run trace.

proposed_resolution.description: Actionable description of what a fixing specification should accomplish. Used verbatim as the requirement passed to start_spec by fix_signal. Null only when no resolution is known at signal creation time.

gating_condition.description: A prerequisite condition that must be satisfied before this signal can be acted on (e.g. 'requires moeb.some-other-spec to be active'). Null when there is no dependency.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the signal. open: the issue persists and no fix has been applied; the signal is eligible for fix_signal selection. resolved: the specific issue described was directly fixed by a spec or run — the proposed_resolution was implemented. superseded: a different design decision made the proposed_resolution unnecessary; the problem class is addressed by a change of approach rather than a direct fix. Use links[] to reference the artifact that resolved or superseded this signal.

links.description: References to artifacts that explain the signal's lifecycle transitions. Expected when status is resolved or superseded; may be omitted when open. Each entry names an artifact type, its identifier, and the relationship type.

artifactType.description: The kind of artifact being referenced. spec: a moeb specification file, identified by domain.slug. signal: another signal in the catalogue, identified by its UUID signal_id. run: a moeb run artifact, identified by its UUID run_id. branch: a git branch, identified by its branch name.

id.description: Identifier of the referenced artifact. Format varies by artifactType — spec: '<domain>.<slug>' (e.g. 'moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path'); signal: UUID v4 signal_id (e.g. 'b3c4d5e6-f7a8-4b90-c123-d4e5f6a7b8c9'); run: UUID v4 run_id; branch: git branch name (e.g. 'feat/fix-<slug>').

type.description: Nature of the relationship. superseded_by: the referenced artifact adopted a different approach that made this signal's proposed_resolution unnecessary. resolved_by: the referenced artifact directly implemented the fix described in proposed_resolution. related_to: informational cross-reference with no lifecycle dependency. caused_by: the referenced artifact introduced the condition or regression that triggered this signal. fix: the referenced branch was created by fix_signal to autonomously resolve this signal.

occurrence_count.description: Total number of times this signal condition has been observed across all runs. Must equal the length of the occurrences array.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the first recorded occurrence. Equals occurrences[0].timestamp.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent occurrence. Equals first_seen when occurrence_count is 1.

occurrences.description: Ordered list of individual occurrences, oldest first. Each entry records when the signal condition was observed and in which run.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of this individual occurrence.

run_id.description: UUID of the moeb run in which this occurrence was observed.

picked_up_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp set by fix_signal when this signal is selected for autonomous resolution. Absence means the signal has not been picked up. Presence prevents re-selection by subsequent fix_signal invocations.
